title: himgd image packs and menuhandbook (Clan Primer) file family

container.notes: Little-endian. Detect by magic: 'himgd\0\0\0' = image pack, 'hctgf\0\0\0' = category index (menuhandbook_<cat>.bin), 'hcomg\0\0\0' = global rules (menuhandbook.bin); any other menuhandbook_*.dat is an FFXII text table. himgd: u16 index at 0x08 (preserve), u16 imageCount at 0x0A, u32 absolute image offsets from 0x0C (0 = absent), header zero-padded to 16, then TIM2 images each zero-padded to 16. Image length = next larger non-zero offset minus this offset (end of file for the highest).

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: 68 69 6D 67 64 00 00 00 ('himgd' + 3 zero bytes)

fields.name: index
fields.notes: Unknown identifier, meaningful in vanilla (the reference packer cannot rebuild it and writes 0). Preserve.

fields.name: imageCount
fields.notes: Number of u32 slots in the image offset table.

records.name: himgdImageOffset
records.where: himgd file offset 12; slot i at 12 + 4*i; table followed by zero padding to a 16-byte boundary

fields.name: offset
fields.notes: Absolute file offset of TIM2 image i, multiple of 16; 0 = empty slot (keep it 0 and keep slot numbering).

fields.name: type
fields.notes: Meaning unknown.

fields.name: entryBasicInfoOffset
fields.notes: Absolute file offset of the hctgfEntryBasicInfo table. Recompute if anything before it changes length.

fields.name: entryExtendedInfoOffset
fields.notes: Absolute file offset of the hctgfEntryExtendedInfo table.

fields.name: headerBasicInfoCount
fields.notes: Number of s32 page-name text ids that start at file offset 0x18.

fields.name: imagesFileLinkOffset
fields.notes: Base link into the himgd image files.

fields.name: imagesFileCount
fields.notes: Number of image files used by this category.

records.name: hctgfHeaderBasicInfo
records.where: menuhandbook_<cat>.bin file offset 24 (0x18), directly after hctgfHeader

fields.name: name
fields.notes: Text id of a header/page name.

records.name: hctgfEntryExtendedInfo
records.where: menuhandbook_<cat>.bin file offset hctgfHeader.entryExtendedInfoOffset (table padded to 4 at its end)

fields.name: imageFileLink
fields.notes: Link to an image file (observed range about 0-296).

fields.name: name
fields.notes: Text id of the entry name.

fields.name: headerBasicInfoLink
fields.notes: Index into hctgfHeaderBasicInfo.

fields.name: textFileLink
fields.notes: Which text table (.dat) holds the entry body.

fields.name: entryExtendedInfoLink
fields.notes: Index into hctgfEntryExtendedInfo.

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: Only bit 0 is known; the reference writer clears the other bits.

fields.name: reserved11
fields.notes: Unused; written as 0.

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: 68 63 6F 6D 67 00 00 00 ('hcomg' + 3 zero bytes)

fields.name: scrivenerBlockRelOffset
fields.notes: 8 + value = file offset of the scrivener block (0x3C when rebuilt).

fields.name: cartographerMapCount
fields.notes: 384; fixed in the executable.

fields.name: cartographerMapBits
fields.notes: Bit (i % 8) of byte (i / 8) set = map i is required for the Cartographer achievement.

records.name: hcomgScrivenerEntry
records.where: menuhandbook.bin scrivener block + 8 (block: u16 next, u16 requiredFoeCount <= 512, u16 unused, u16 entryCount, then entries)

fields.name: requirementValue
fields.notes: Type 0: required story progress. Type 1: required bestiary id.

records.name: hcomgHuntEntry
records.where: menuhandbook.bin hunt block + 4 (block: u16 next, u16 count, entries, zero pad to 4)

roundTrip: himgd: preserve the u16 index at 0x08, imageCount, slot order and zero slots; write images at 16-byte boundaries followed by zero padding.
himgd: header table is zero-padded to 16 after the last offset slot.

hctgf: after any length change, rebuild entryBasicInfoOffset, entryExtendedInfoOffset and the two block-relative u16 offset lists; keep the 4-byte alignment inside the header-extended block and after the extended table, and 16-byte alignment around the footer block and at end of file.
hcomg: each block's first u16 is the distance from that u16 to the next block; the last block stores the unpadded end-of-data distance; pad the file to 16.
Never change hcomg cartographerMapCount (384) or the defeated-foe figure count (10).
